zh: 得分分成两部分：每个 T 格子自身的分值，以及每一对相邻且都是 T 的格子额外得到的 1 分。
连续 k 个 T 会形成 k−1 对相邻的 T，每一对都要加 1 分，而不是整段只加一次。
从左到右扫描：当前格是 T 就加上它的分值，若前一格也是 T 再加 1；最后输出总分。
en: The score has two parts: the value of every T cell, and one extra point for every pair of adjacent cells that are both T.
A run of k consecutive Ts forms k-1 adjacent T pairs, and each pair adds a point; the run does not get just a single bonus.
Scan from left to right: when the current cell is T add its value, and if the previous cell is also T add 1 more; print the total at the end.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First add up the values of all T cells, then check each pair of adjacent cells for whether both are T. A run of k consecutive Ts contributes k−1 adjacent pairs, not a single bonus.

## Why It Is Correct

Each base point corresponds uniquely to one T cell, and each bonus point corresponds uniquely to one T-T adjacent edge. The loop checks each cell and each adjacent edge exactly once, so nothing is repeated or missed.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1) besides the input.
